page.layout: One page of text, single column. Page number at top right. Below it: heading IOANNES BAPTISTA PASSERVS with subtitle Genua Patauinus. Then an italic paragraph, a Latin epigram in six verse lines, a heading AVBERTVS MIRÆVS with a bibliographic subtitle, an italic paragraph, and a catchword at bottom right. No margin notes.

main_text.head: IOANNES BAPTISTA PASSERVS Genua Patauinus.

p.i: Caufam tueri nesciunt, nolunt, aut nequeunt Hæretici, nisi aculeatis probris inuehantur in Orthodoxos, & proscindant genio, & ingenio indulgentes: imbecillitatis indicium. Nam sat est proftraffe Leoni. Monstrum de Ioanna Papissa, vel fabulam discerpit Leo Allatius, vt conuicijs abstineat, & Leonem agat. Feram interficere, ac triumphare tentarunt multi, sed frustra. Vni Leoni Allatio amarantina gloria, gloriosus triumphus.

main_text.p: Torserat in monstrum validus lethalia miles Tela, sed irrifit vulnera magna ferox. Sæpe refurgit ouans: fortem timet ecce Leonem, Aggreditur, lacerat: ficta Ioanna perit. Namque Leo superat fortissimus omnia monstra: Parcit & inuictus: præstat utrumque Leo.
main_text.head: AVBERTVS MIRÆVS In Chronico Belgico edito Antuerpiæ in fol. Anno 1636. pag. 184.

p.i: De Ioanna Papissa. Quin etiam Photius ipse, qui illa ætate vixit nullo interiecto Leoni Benedictum, huic Nicolaum, tum Ioannem substituit, vt Leo Allatius accurate docet in sua Commentatione 1630. Roma edita.

page.notes: The verse stanza is printed in roman type and indented; it is kept as one paragraph with its line breaks. A stray mark at the right margin midway down the page is not printed text and is left out. The line-end hyphens after "Ioannem" and "in" are read as line breaks, so no hyphen is kept in those words. The long-s letters in "proftraffe" and "Caufam" are transcribed as plain s and f as printed.
